new_value: Fixed: added defensive NULL check on pkt at the top of lichen_l2_send() in firmware/bridge-zephyr/subsys/lichen/lichen_l2.c (before net_pkt_get_len at line ~920), returning -EINVAL with LOG_ERR per the file's log policy (LOG_ERR = programming errors/NULL params). Scope note: the reviewed revision (2026-06-27) had the NULL check at old line 307 far from the get_len call; the file was since refactored to 'trust the net_l2 contract' with no pkt check at all, so this restores the check adjacent to first dereference with a bead-referenced defense-in-depth comment. Verified: clang -fsyntax-only -std=c11 -Wall --target=armv7m-none-eabi (32-bit, matches TU's documented target assumptions) with stub Zephyr headers and Kconfig-default -D flags: exit 0, zero diagnostics; host pass also exit 0. CI gap: native_sim / pinned Zephyr v3.7.0 build not runnable locally, so this was not verified under a real Zephyr build.
